rule.statement: The rights of Siyathu with respect to Bogahakumburehena did not devolve on Punchi Appuhamy.
rule.supporting_quote: (29) Accordingly I hold that; the rights of Siyathu(4) with respect to Bogahakumburehena did not devolve on Punchi Appuhamy on Deeds Nos. 6810 (P20) and 6180 (P21) and I hold further that the rights of Siyathu were seized in the execution of the Decree in Case No. L/6625 and were sold to Kirihamy.
